title: Carve-Out Reach of a Home Oxygen Therapy Closing Day, by Coverage Class
content:
# Carve-Out Reach of the Closing Day — Home Oxygen Therapy

**Schedule rule.** When Home Oxygen Therapy equipment is returned, the record closes on the day the need ended instead of the day of confirmation only when the day the need ended is no more than the reach below before the confirmation. The reach depends on the coverage named on the oxygen record, read by its class in the patient's Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility records. Days are calendar days, counted as the later date less the earlier date. When the condition fails, the record closes on the day the return is confirmed.

| Coverage class named on the oxygen record | Carve-out reach (days before the confirmation) |
|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | 365 |
| Medicare Supplement Plan G | 365 |
| Medicare Advantage PPO | 180 |
| Medicare Advantage HMO | 180 |
| any other coverage class (for example Commercial PPO, Commercial HMO, Medicaid Fee-for-Service) | 0 |

## Both sides (hypothetical)

| Coverage class | Day the need ended, days before the confirmation | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | 365 | met |
| Original Medicare Part B | 366 | fails |
| Medicare Advantage HMO | 180 | met |
| Medicare Advantage HMO | 181 | fails |
| Commercial PPO | 0 (same day) | met |
| Commercial PPO | 1 | fails |
